lines.text: Pour some juice into water, stir, then pour some back.
lines.caption: Pour some juice into water, stir, then pour some back.

lines.text: How much of the drink is juice now? Lots of kids get mixed up here!
lines.caption: How much of the drink is juice now? Lots of kids get mixed up here!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's follow the juice, one pour at a time.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's follow the juice, one pour at a time.

lines.text: Here's the question.
lines.caption: Here's the question.

lines.text: Jug A holds ten liters of water.
lines.caption: Jug A holds ten liters of water.

lines.text: Jug B holds ten liters of a drink that is sixty percent juice.
lines.caption: Jug B holds ten liters of a drink that is sixty percent juice.

lines.text: Five liters are poured from jug B into jug A and stirred.
lines.caption: Five liters are poured from jug B into jug A and stirred.

lines.text: Then five liters are poured from jug A back into jug B.
lines.caption: Then five liters are poured from jug A back into jug B.

lines.text: What percent of the drink in jug B is now juice?
lines.caption: What percent of the drink in jug B is now juice?

lines.text: Here are the five choices.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices.

lines.text: There are two pours. First from B into A, then from A back into B.
lines.caption: There are two pours. First from B into A, then from A back into B.

lines.text: Stirred means the drink is mixed evenly. Every scoop is the same.
lines.caption: Stirred means the drink is mixed evenly. Every scoop is the same.

lines.text: At the end, we want the share of jug B that is juice.
lines.caption: At the end, we want the share of jug B that is juice.

lines.text: Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Here's the strategy: count liters of juice, not percents.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Here's the strategy: count liters of juice, not percents.

lines.text: At the start, jug A has no juice. Jug B has sixty percent of ten liters. That's six liters of juice.
lines.caption: At the start, jug A has no juice. Jug B has sixty percent of ten liters. That's six liters of juice.

lines.text: First pour. Five liters is half of jug B.
lines.caption: First pour. Five liters is half of jug B.

lines.text: So half of its juice moves too. Half of six is three liters of juice.
lines.caption: So half of its juice moves too. Half of six is three liters of juice.

lines.text: Now jug A has fifteen liters, with three liters of juice.
lines.caption: Now jug A has fifteen liters, with three liters of juice.

lines.text: Jug B has five liters, with three liters of juice.
lines.caption: Jug B has five liters, with three liters of juice.

lines.text: Jug A is three out of fifteen juice. That's one fifth, or twenty percent.
lines.caption: Jug A is three out of fifteen juice. That's one fifth, or twenty percent.

lines.text: Second pour. Five liters is one third of jug A.
lines.caption: Second pour. Five liters is one third of jug A.

lines.text: One third of its three liters of juice is one liter. That liter goes back to jug B.
lines.caption: One third of its three liters of juice is one liter. That liter goes back to jug B.

lines.text: Jug B is back to ten liters, with three plus one, four liters of juice.
lines.caption: Jug B is back to ten liters, with three plus one, four liters of juice.

lines.text: Four out of ten is forty percent. That's Choice C!
lines.caption: Four out of ten is forty percent. That's Choice C!

lines.text: Here's a shortcut. Juice never disappears. There are six liters of juice in all, the whole time.
lines.caption: Here's a shortcut. Juice never disappears. There are six liters of juice in all, the whole time.

lines.text: Pouring out of jug A doesn't change its mix.
lines.caption: Pouring out of jug A doesn't change its mix.

lines.text: It stays twenty percent juice. Fifteen minus five leaves ten liters.
lines.caption: It stays twenty percent juice. Fifteen minus five leaves ten liters.

lines.text: So jug A keeps twenty percent of ten, two liters of juice.
lines.caption: So jug A keeps twenty percent of ten, two liters of juice.

lines.text: The rest is in jug B: six minus two is four liters. Four out of ten, forty percent!
lines.caption: The rest is in jug B: six minus two is four liters. Four out of ten, forty percent!

lines.text: When would you pick this way? When one jug is easier to figure out. Then subtract from the total.
lines.caption: When would you pick this way? When one jug is easier to figure out. Then subtract from the total.

lines.text: Now the traps. Choice A, twenty percent, is the right number for the wrong jug.
lines.caption: Now the traps. Choice A, twenty percent, is the right number for the wrong jug.

lines.text: That's jug A, not jug B!
lines.caption: That's jug A, not jug B!

lines.text: Choice B, thirty percent, counts only the three liters left in jug B.
lines.caption: Choice B, thirty percent, counts only the three liters left in jug B.

lines.text: It forgets the liter of juice that came back.
lines.caption: It forgets the liter of juice that came back.

lines.text: Choice D, forty-five, is what you'd get by averaging trap B's thirty with the starting sixty.
lines.caption: Choice D, forty-five, is what you'd get by averaging trap B's thirty with the starting sixty.

lines.text: Averaging percents doesn't work here.
lines.caption: Averaging percents doesn't work here.

lines.text: Choice E, sixty percent, is where jug B started. But the pours traded some of its juice for water.
lines.caption: Choice E, sixty percent, is where jug B started. But the pours traded some of its juice for water.

lines.text: Only forty percent tracks every liter of juice.
lines.caption: Only forty percent tracks every liter of juice.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Jug A has eight liters of water.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Jug A has eight liters of water.

lines.text: Jug B has eight liters of a drink that is seventy-five percent juice.
lines.caption: Jug B has eight liters of a drink that is seventy-five percent juice.

lines.text: Pour four liters from B into A and stir. Then pour four liters back. What percent of jug B is juice?
lines.caption: Pour four liters from B into A and stir. Then pour four liters back. What percent of jug B is juice?

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. Jug B starts with seventy-five percent of eight, six liters of juice.
lines.caption: Let's check. Jug B starts with seventy-five percent of eight, six liters of juice.

lines.text: Four liters is half of jug B, so three liters of juice go into jug A.
lines.caption: Four liters is half of jug B, so three liters of juice go into jug A.

lines.text: Jug A now has twelve liters, with three liters of juice.
lines.caption: Jug A now has twelve liters, with three liters of juice.

lines.text: Four liters is one third of jug A, so one liter of juice comes back.
lines.caption: Four liters is one third of jug A, so one liter of juice comes back.

lines.text: Jug B has eight liters again, with three plus one, four liters of juice.
lines.caption: Jug B has eight liters again, with three plus one, four liters of juice.

lines.text: Four out of eight is fifty percent!
lines.caption: Four out of eight is fifty percent!

lines.text: If you got fifty percent, wonderful work!
lines.caption: If you got fifty percent, wonderful work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: Count liters of juice, not percents.
lines.caption: Count liters of juice, not percents.

lines.text: When you pour out part of a jug, that same part of its juice goes too.
lines.caption: When you pour out part of a jug, that same part of its juice goes too.

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep pouring your brain into math, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep pouring your brain into math, and I'll see you next time!
